contract_decision: stage26 defines the opt-in Rust daemon candidate inventory, selector rules, isolated smoke layout, and Go baseline command queue; it does not implement or start a candidate daemon and keeps all default/product switches blocked
denied_default_mutations: do not alias dae-cli-optin to dae run
do not switch Makefile dae output to a Rust daemon artifact
do not mark release assets as Rust-default-daemon-ready
do not start a live candidate from the plan helper

inventory_rows.boundary: dae-cli-optin is not aliased to dae run and is not packaged as the default daemon artifact
inventory_rows.evidence: rust/crates/dae-cli/src/bin/dae-cli-optin.rs dispatches explicit opt-in helper commands through dae_cli::run_with_args_and_version
inventory_rows.next_action: keep every candidate run behind an explicit selector and keep Go-backed dae as the default artifact

inventory_rows.boundary: the helper does not start a daemon; --write only creates files under the requested /tmp root
inventory_rows.evidence: dae-cli-optin runtime stage26-candidate-plan emits artifact inventory, selector contract, /tmp layout, Go baseline commands, and candidate command queue
inventory_rows.next_action: use this selector as the contract for the later stage26-run-candidate implementation

inventory_rows.boundary: Stage 26 cannot mutate package names, systemd ExecStart, release labels, or dae-wing/daed defaults
inventory_rows.evidence: Makefile dae, release/prerelease workflows, and install/dae.service still target the Go-backed dae run path
inventory_rows.next_action: capture Go baseline commands before any Rust candidate live run

inventory_rows.boundary: candidate progress override is a required blocker before live run because Go reload progress still defaults to /var/run/dae.progress
inventory_rows.evidence: candidate plan defines /tmp/dae-stage26-candidate config, run, pid, progress, log, traffic, sockets, assets, and cache paths
inventory_rows.next_action: implement candidate live smoke only after progress/pid/log/cache paths remain isolated

inventory_rows.boundary: these commands are a baseline plan, not matched daemon benchmark evidence
inventory_rows.evidence: candidate plan lists make dae, --version, validate, and export outline commands for /tmp/dae-stage26-go-baseline/dae
inventory_rows.next_action: run Go baseline before Rust candidate smoke and record outputs in the local plan

inventory_rows.boundary: no Rust daemon process is admitted or started by Stage 26
inventory_rows.evidence: candidate plan intentionally marks stage26-run-candidate as blocked-unimplemented and candidate_live_run_allowed=false
inventory_rows.next_action: Stage 27 may implement the opt-in run candidate after selector, layout, and baseline rules are fixed

inventory_rows.boundary: Stage 26 cannot set true_rust_default_daemon_admitted or final_100_percent_admitted
inventory_rows.evidence: outbound true dataplane, matched Go-vs-Rust default daemon benchmark, and clean dae-wing/daed recertification remain required
inventory_rows.next_action: keep all default mutations denied until the Stage 25 rows pass with recorded evidence

name: stage26-true-rust-daemon-candidate-contract
selector_rules: accepted selector is dae-cli-optin runtime stage26-candidate-plan
future candidate run selector must be explicit and must include --root under /tmp
dae run remains Go-backed until true Rust default daemon admission passes
implicit environment-only default switches are forbidden
dae-wing and daed defaults cannot change from dae-local evidence alone
Go fallback selector and artifact must remain available
validation_commands: cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p dae-cli --bin dae-cli-optin --quiet -- runtime stage26-candidate-plan --root /tmp/dae-stage26-candidate
